welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.intro: Thank you for using our application. Here are some tips to get started:

tips.camera: Use camera settings to adjust the view.
tips.lighting: Configure lighting to highlight your model.
tips.background: Customize the background with a color or image.
tips.brightness: The "Background > Brightness" option really changes the mockup design, I recommend playing with it
tips.crop: Use cropping options to get the desired result.
tips.desktop: Use a computer, the site is not designed for small screens

warnings.cropErrors: Some options like crop are subject to errors
warnings.maxPanels: You can only open 2 panels at a time
warnings.singleModel: Currently only one model is available: iPhone
warnings.noResize: No option to resize the mockup for now. Recommended video format: 1080x2400
warnings.originalSize: *Original size when you film your phone from your phone

welcome.opensource: Open source project with client-side rendering only without any data storage
